versos.grego: Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ Λόγος, καὶ ὁ Λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν Θεόν, καὶ Θεὸς ἦν ὁ Λόγος.

controles.web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
controles.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
controles.livre: No princípio era a Palavra,  e a Palavra estava junto de Deus, e a Palavra era Deus.

versos.grego: Οὗτος ἦν ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν.

controles.web: The same was in the beginning with God.
controles.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.
controles.livre: Esta estava no princípio junto de Deus.

versos.grego: πάντα δι’ αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ χωρὶς αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο οὐδὲ ἕν ὃ γέγονεν.

controles.web: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.
controles.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
controles.livre: Por esta foram feitas todas as coisas, e sem ela não se fez coisa nenhuma do que foi feito.

versos.grego: ἐν αὐτῷ ζωὴ ἦν, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἦν τὸ φῶς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
controles.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
controles.livre: Nela estava a vida, e a vida era a luz dos seres humanos.

versos.grego: καὶ τὸ φῶς ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ φαίνει, καὶ ἡ σκοτία αὐτὸ οὐ κατέλαβεν.

controles.web: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome  it.
controles.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
controles.livre: E a luz brilha nas trevas; e as trevas não a compreenderam.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο ἄνθρωπος, ἀπεσταλμένος παρὰ Θεοῦ, ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ἰωάνης·

controles.web: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
controles.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
controles.livre: Houve um homem enviado por Deus, cujo nome era João.

versos.grego: οὗτος ἦλθεν εἰς μαρτυρίαν, ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός, ἵνα πάντες πιστεύσωσιν δι’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
controles.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
controles.livre: Este veio por testemunho, para que testemunhasse da Luz, para que todos por ele cressem.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖνος τὸ φῶς, ἀλλ’ ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός.

controles.web: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
controles.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
controles.livre: Ele não era a Luz; mas foi enviado para que testemunhasse da Luz.

versos.grego: Ἦν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν, ὃ φωτίζει πάντα ἄνθρωπον, ἐρχόμενον εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

controles.web: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
controles.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
controles.livre: Esta era a luz verdadeira, que ilumina a todo ser humano que vem ao mundo.

versos.grego: ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἦν, καὶ ὁ κόσμος δι’ αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτὸν οὐκ ἔγνω.

controles.web: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
controles.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
controles.livre: No mundo estava, e por ele foi feito o mundo; e o mundo não o conheceu.

versos.grego: εἰς τὰ ἴδια ἦλθεν, καὶ οἱ ἴδιοι αὐτὸν οὐ παρέλαβον.

controles.web: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
controles.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
controles.livre: Ao seu próprio veio, e os seus não o receberam.

versos.grego: ὅσοι δὲ ἔλαβον αὐτόν, ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τέκνα Θεοῦ γενέσθαι, τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
controles.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
controles.livre: Mas a todos quantos o receberam, deu-lhes poder de serem feitos filhos de Deus: aos que creem em seu nome.

versos.grego: οἳ οὐκ ἐξ αἱμάτων οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος σαρκὸς οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος ἀνδρὸς ἀλλ’ ἐκ Θεοῦ ἐγεννήθησαν.

controles.web: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
controles.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
controles.livre: Os quais não são gerados de sangue, nem de vontade da carne, nem de vontade de homem, mas sim de Deus.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ Λόγος σὰρξ ἐγένετο καὶ ἐσκήνωσεν ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ ἐθεασάμεθα τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, δόξαν ὡς μονογενοῦς παρὰ Πατρός, πλήρης χάριτος καὶ ἀληθείας.

controles.web: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
controles.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
controles.livre: E aquela Palavra se fez carne, e habitou entre nós; (e vimos sua glória, como glória do unigênito do Pai) cheio de graça e de verdade.

versos.grego: Ἰωάνης μαρτυρεῖ περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ κέκραγεν λέγων Οὗτος ἦν ὃν εἶπον Ὁ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἔμπροσθέν μου γέγονεν, ὅτι πρῶτός μου ἦν.

controles.web: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
controles.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
controles.livre: E João dele testemunhou, e clamou, dizendo: Este era aquele, de quem eu dizia: O que vem após mim é antes de mim; porque era primeiro que eu.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πληρώματος αὐτοῦ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἐλάβομεν, καὶ χάριν ἀντὶ χάριτος·

controles.web: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
controles.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
controles.livre: E de sua plenitude recebemos todos também graça por graça.

versos.grego: ὅτι ὁ νόμος διὰ Μωϋσέως ἐδόθη, ἡ χάρις καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐγένετο.

controles.web: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Porque a Lei foi dada por Moisés; a graça e a verdade foi feita por Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Θεὸν οὐδεὶς ἑώρακεν πώποτε· μονογενὴς Θεὸς ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κόλπον τοῦ Πατρὸς, ἐκεῖνος ἐξηγήσατο.

controles.web: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.
controles.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
controles.livre: A Deus nunca ninguém o viu; o unigênito Deus  , que está no seio do Pai, ele o declarou.

versos.grego: Καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Ἰωάνου ὅτε ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐξ Ἱεροσολύμων ἱερεῖς καὶ Λευείτας ἵνα ἐρωτήσωσιν αὐτόν Σὺ τίς εἶ;

controles.web: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
controles.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
controles.livre: E este é o testemunho de João, quando os judeus mandaram alguns sacerdotes e levitas de Jerusalém, que lhe perguntassem: Tu quem és?

versos.grego: καὶ ὡμολόγησεν καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσατο, καὶ ὡμολόγησεν ὅτι Ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ὁ Χριστός.

controles.web: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
controles.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
controles.livre: E confessou, e não negou; e confessou: Eu não sou o Cristo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν Τί οὖν; σὺ Ἡλείας εἶ; καὶ λέγει Οὐκ εἰμί. Ὁ προφήτης εἶ σύ; καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Οὔ.

controles.web: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?”   He said, “I am not.”   “Are you the prophet?”   He answered, “No.”
controles.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
controles.livre: E lhe perguntaram: Que, então? És tu Elias? E ele disse: Não sou. Eles disseram : Tu és o Profeta? E ele respondeu: Não.

versos.grego: εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ Τίς εἶ; ἵνα ἀπόκρισιν δῶμεν τοῖς πέμψασιν ἡμᾶς· τί λέγεις περὶ σεαυτοῦ;

controles.web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
controles.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois: Quem és? Para darmos resposta aos que nos enviaram. Que dizes de ti mesmo?

versos.grego: ἔφη Ἐγὼ φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Εὐθύνατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου, καθὼς εἶπεν Ἡσαΐας ὁ προφήτης.

controles.web: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
controles.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
controles.livre: Disse: Eu sou a voz do que clama no deserto: Endireitai o caminho do Senhor, como disse o profeta Isaías.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀπεσταλμένοι ἦσαν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων.

controles.web: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
controles.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
controles.livre: E os enviados eram dos fariseus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Τί οὖν βαπτίζεις εἰ σὺ οὐκ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐδὲ Ἡλείας οὐδὲ ὁ προφήτης;

controles.web: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
controles.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
controles.livre: E perguntaram-lhe, e disseram-lhe: Por que pois batizas, se tu não és o Cristo, nem Elias, nem o profeta?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰωάνης λέγων Ἐγὼ βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι· μέσος ὑμῶν στήκει ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε,

controles.web: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
controles.kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
controles.livre: João lhes respondeu, dizendo: Eu batizo com água; mas em meio de vós, está a quem vós não conheceis,

versos.grego: ὁ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ἄξιος ἵνα λύσω αὐτοῦ τὸν ἱμάντα τοῦ ὑποδήματος.

controles.web: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
controles.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
controles.livre: Este é aquele que vem após mim,  do qual eu não sou digno de desatar a tira de sua sandália.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐγένετο πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ὅπου ἦν ὁ Ἰωάνης βαπτίζων.

controles.web: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
controles.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
controles.livre: Estas coisas aconteceram em Betábara, do outro lado do Jordão, onde João estava batizando.

versos.grego: Τῇ ἐπαύριον βλέπει τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐρχόμενον πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ λέγει Ἴδε ὁ Ἀμνὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ αἴρων τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου.

controles.web: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
controles.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
controles.livre: O dia seguinte viu João a Jesus vir a ele, e disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus, que tira o pecado do mundo.

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον Ὀπίσω μου ἔρχεται ἀνὴρ ὃς ἔμπροσθέν μου γέγονεν, ὅτι πρῶτός μου ἦν.

controles.web: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
controles.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
controles.livre: Este é aquele do qual eu disse: Após mim vem um homem que já foi antes de mim; porque já era primeiro que eu.

versos.grego: κἀγὼ οὐκ ᾔδειν αὐτόν, ἀλλ’ ἵνα φανερωθῇ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ, διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον ἐγὼ ἐν ὕδατι βαπτίζων.

controles.web: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”
controles.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
controles.livre: E eu não o conhecia; mas para que fosse manifesto a Israel, por isso vim eu batizando com água.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν Ἰωάνης λέγων ὅτι Τεθέαμαι τὸ Πνεῦμα καταβαῖνον ὡς περιστερὰν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

controles.web: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
controles.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
controles.livre: E João testemunhou, dizendo: Eu vi o Espírito como pomba descer do céu, e repousou sobre ele.

versos.grego: κἀγὼ οὐκ ᾔδειν αὐτόν, ἀλλ’ ὁ πέμψας με βαπτίζειν ἐν ὕδατι ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν Ἐφ’ ὃν ἂν ἴδῃς τὸ Πνεῦμα καταβαῖνον καὶ μένον ἐπ’ αὐτόν, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ.

controles.web: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
controles.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: E eu não o conhecia, mas aquele que me mandou a batizar com água, esse me disse: Sobre aquele que vires descer ao Espírito, e repousar sobre ele, esse é o que batiza com Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: κἀγὼ ἑώρακα, καὶ μεμαρτύρηκα ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
controles.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
controles.livre: E eu o vi, e testemunhado tenho, que este é o Filho de Deus.

versos.grego: Τῇ ἐπαύριον πάλιν εἱστήκει ὁ Ἰωάνης καὶ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ δύο,

controles.web: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
controles.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
controles.livre: O seguinte dia estava outra vez ali João, e dois de seus discípulos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμβλέψας τῷ Ἰησοῦ περιπατοῦντι λέγει Ἴδε ὁ Ἀμνὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
controles.kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
controles.livre: E vendo por ali andar a Jesus, disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ δύο μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος καὶ ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
controles.kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
controles.livre: E os dois discípulos ouviram-lhe dizer aquilo , e seguiram a Jesus.

versos.grego: στραφεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ θεασάμενος αὐτοὺς ἀκολουθοῦντας λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί ζητεῖτε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ῥαββεί, (ὃ λέγεται μεθερμηνευόμενον Διδάσκαλε,) ποῦ μένεις;

controles.web: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?”   They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
controles.kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
controles.livre: E Jesus, virando-se, e vendo-os seguir, disse-lhes: Que buscais? E eles lhe disseram: Rabi, (que traduzido, quer dizer, Mestre) onde moras?

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἔρχεσθε καὶ ὄψεσθε. ἦλθαν οὖν καὶ εἶδαν ποῦ μένει, καὶ παρ’ αὐτῷ ἔμειναν τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην· ὥρα ἦν ὡς δεκάτη.

controles.web: He said to them, “Come, and see.”   They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
controles.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes ele: Vinde, e vede-o; Vieram, e viram onde morava, e na companhia dele naquele dia; e já era quase a hora décima.

versos.grego: Ἦν Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου εἷς ἐκ τῶν δύο τῶν ἀκουσάντων παρὰ Ἰωάνου καὶ ἀκολουθησάντων αὐτῷ·

controles.web: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
controles.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
controles.livre: Era André, o irmão de Simão Pedro, um dos dois que ouvira aquilo de João, e o haviam seguido.

versos.grego: εὑρίσκει οὗτος πρῶτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τὸν ἴδιον Σίμωνα καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Εὑρήκαμεν τὸν Μεσσίαν (ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Χριστός).

controles.web: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
controles.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
controles.livre: Este achou primeiro a seu irmão Simão, e disse-lhe: Já achamos ao Messias(que traduzido, é o Cristo).

versos.grego: ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν. ἐμβλέψας αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Σὺ εἶ Σίμων ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωάνου, σὺ κληθήσῃ Κηφᾶς (ὃ ἑρμηνεύεται Πέτρος).

controles.web: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
controles.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
controles.livre: E levou-o a Jesus. E Jesus, olhando para ele, disse: Tu és Simão, filho de Jonas; tu serás chamado Cefas. (que se traduz Pedro).

versos.grego: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ἠθέλησεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν. καὶ εὑρίσκει Φίλιππον. καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀκολούθει μοι.

controles.web: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
controles.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
controles.livre: O dia seguinte Jesus quis ir à Galileia, achou Filipe, e disse-lhe: Segue-me.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος ἀπὸ Βηθσαϊδά, ἐκ τῆς πόλεως Ἀνδρέου καὶ Πέτρου.

controles.web: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
controles.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
controles.livre: E Filipe era de Betsaida, da cidade de André e de Pedro.

versos.grego: εὑρίσκει Φίλιππος τὸν Ναθαναὴλ καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὃν ἔγραψεν Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ νόμῳ καὶ οἱ προφῆται εὑρήκαμεν, Ἰησοῦν υἱὸν τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἀπὸ Ναζαρέτ.

controles.web: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
controles.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
controles.livre: Filipe achou Natanael, e disse-lhe: Achamos aquele de quem Moisés escreveu na Lei, e os Profetas: a Jesus, o filho de José, de Nazaré.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ Ἐκ Ναζαρὲτ δύναταί τι ἀγαθὸν εἶναι; λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Φίλιππος Ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε.

controles.web: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?”   Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
controles.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe Natanael: Pode haver alguma coisa boa de Nazaré? Filipe lhe disse: Vem, e vê.

versos.grego: εἶδεν Ἰησοῦς τὸν Ναθαναὴλ ἐρχόμενον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει περὶ αὐτοῦ Ἴδε ἀληθῶς Ἰσραηλείτης, ἐν ᾧ δόλος οὐκ ἔστιν.

controles.web: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
controles.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
controles.livre: Jesus viu Natanael vir, e disse dele: Eis verdadeiramente um israelita, em quem não há engano!

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ Πόθεν με γινώσκεις; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Πρὸ τοῦ σε Φίλιππον φωνῆσαι ὄντα ὑπὸ τὴν συκῆν εἶδόν σε.

controles.web: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?”   Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
controles.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
controles.livre: Natanael lhe disse: De onde tu me conheces? Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Antes que Filipe te chamasse, estando tu debaixo da figueira, eu te vi.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ Ῥαββεί, σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ, σὺ Βασιλεὺς εἶ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

controles.web: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
controles.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
controles.livre: Natanael respondeu, e disse-lhe: Rabi, tu és o Filho de Deus, tu és o Rei de Israel!

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὅτι εἶπόν σοι ὅτι εἶδόν σε ὑποκάτω τῆς συκῆς, πιστεύεις; μείζω τούτων ὄψῃ.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
controles.livre: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Porque te disse: Debaixo da figueira te vi, crês? Tu verás coisas maiores que estas.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὄψεσθε τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳγότα καὶ τοὺς ἀγγέλους τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀναβαίνοντας καὶ καταβαίνοντας ἐπὶ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
controles.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que daqui em diante vereis o céu aberto, e aos anjos de Deus subir e descer sobre o Filho do homem.
